scenarios.name: upkeep-creates-half-the-zombies-rounded-down
scenarios.why: At the controller's upkeep it creates X 2/2 Zombie tokens where X is half the Zombies you control rounded down. With three other Zombies controlled, X is 1.

scenarios.name: no-other-zombies-creates-none
scenarios.why: With zero other Zombies, half of zero rounded down is zero, so no tokens are created even though the trigger resolves.
